items.title: Yum! Brands (YUM) Unveils KFC Muse Flagship In Dubai
items.summary: Yum! Brands (NYSE:YUM) introduced KFC Muse, a new global flagship restaurant design, with an inaugural site in Dubai. The KFC Muse format debuts a fresh visual identity along with a more immersive in store environment for guests. The Dubai flagship showcases bespoke offerings, including the KWENCH beverage range and customizable KFC MIX'D meal options. A second KFC Muse location is planned for Seoul, signaling Yum!
